title: Memorization Over Reasoning? Exposing and Mitigating Verbatim Memorization in Large Language Models’ Character Understanding Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance drops on character understanding benchmarks by applying soft (gist-based prompting) and hard (cross-cultural name replacement, name masking) interventions to disrupt verbatim recall of pretraining data and measure models' reliance on memorized surface cues rather than genuine reasoning.
